kebab_example: aliyun agentcore update-service-endpoint --workspace-id ws-0123456789abcdef01234 --service-endpoint-id se-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --api-version 2026-08-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace to which the service endpoint to be updated belongs. You can obtain the ID by calling the ListWorkspaces operation
parameters.help_zh: 待更新服务端点所属的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID，可通过 ListWorkspaces 获取
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service endpoint to be updated. You can obtain the ID by calling the ListServiceEndpoints operation. The service endpoint must belong to the workspace specified in the request
parameters.help_zh: 待更新服务端点的 ID，可通过 ListServiceEndpoints 获取。该服务端点须属于请求指定的工作空间
parameters.name: service_endpoint_id

fields.help_en: If omitted, the original binding is retained. If specified, it must be an exact and successful source version of the agent. Otherwise, ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady is returned. When rebinding a DEFAULT service endpoint of the GATEWAY_API type, ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady is also returned if the original gateway runtime instance is unavailable
fields.help_zh: 不传表示保持原绑定；传入时必须是该智能体已成功的精确源版本，否则返回 ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady；GATEWAY_API 类型的 DEFAULT 服务端点改绑时，原网关运行实例不可用也返回 ServiceEndpointTargetNotReady
fields.name: agent_version

fields.help_en: The saved invocation authentication type. Valid values: NONE: Configured not to use the endpoint API key. API_KEY: Configured to use the endpoint API key. For AGENT_VERSION endpoints of non-EDGE agents, the actual API key verification is determined by the current inbound authentication configuration of the agent and cannot be determined solely based on this field. You must provide type when passing authentication
fields.help_zh: 保存的调用认证类型：NONE 表示配置为不使用端点 API Key，API_KEY 表示配置为使用端点 API Key。非 EDGE 智能体的 AGENT_VERSION 类型端点，实际 API Key 校验由 Agent 当前入站认证配置决定，不能仅根据该字段判断。传入 authentication 时必须提供 type
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: Updates the invocation authentication configuration saved for the service endpoint, specified by type. If omitted, the original configuration is retained. This field is prohibited for DEFAULT endpoints. For AGENT_VERSION endpoints of non-EDGE agents, the actual API key verification is determined by the current inbound authentication configuration of the agent. The management API for updating the service endpoint still uses AccessKey or STS authentication and RAM authorization
fields.help_zh: 更新服务端点保存的调用认证配置，通过 type 指定；不传表示保持原配置，DEFAULT 端点禁止传入此字段。非 EDGE 智能体的 AGENT_VERSION 类型端点，实际 API Key 校验由 Agent 当前入站认证配置决定。更新服务端点的管理接口仍使用 AK 或 STS 认证及 RAM 授权
fields.name: authentication

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the dynamic policy. This field is required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original value is retained. Disabling it retains existing policies and restores the basic upper and lower limits. Re-enabling it triggers immediate calculation. When finally enabled, policies cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原值。关闭保留已有策略并恢复基础上下限，重新开启立即计算；最终开启时 policies 不得为空
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The end time of the validity period. This field is required only when validity is set to range. The format is the same as startTime, and the seconds are fixed at 00. It must be later than startTime. The interval does not include the end time. If validity is set to forever, the start and end times must be omitted. Valid dates and cross-field constraints are validated by the console
fields.help_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，格式与 startTime 相同，秒位固定 00，必须晚于 startTime；区间不包含结束时刻。forever 必须省略起止时间；合法日期和跨字段约束由 Console 校验
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The policy identifier. This field is required and must be unique and stable within the endpoint. It is generated by the frontend when added, and retained during editing and retries
fields.help_zh: 必填，Endpoint 内唯一且稳定；新增时由前端生成，编辑和重试保留
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The policy priority. This field is required. Valid values: 5: Regular. 10: High. New policies default to regular. You must explicitly provide this field upon submission, as the API does not set a default value. When the final dynamicPolicy.enabled is set to true, the validity periods of high-priority policies cannot overlap, except for end-to-end connections. Long-term high-priority policies can overlap with other high-priority policies. When disabled, overlapping drafts can be saved, and the final configuration is validated upon re-enabling. The validity of other fields and trigger conflicts within the policy are always validated. You must explicitly provide priority
fields.help_zh: 必填，5 为常规，10 为高优；新增策略默认选择常规，提交时显式携带，不设置接口默认值。最终 dynamicPolicy.enabled=true 时，高优策略之间有效期不得重叠，首尾相接允许，长期高优与其他高优重叠；关闭时允许保存重叠草稿，重新开启时校验最终配置。其他字段合法性与策略内触发冲突始终校验；priority 必须显式提供
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The repeat cycle. This field is required. Valid values: daily: Every day. weekly: Every week. monthly: Every month. Only submit the fields corresponding to the cycle
fields.help_zh: 必填。daily 为每天，weekly 为每星期，monthly 为每月；仅提交对应周期的字段
fields.name: repeat

fields.help_en: The start time of the validity period. This field is required only when validity is set to range. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss in the policy time zone, without a time zone offset. The seconds are fixed at 00. The interval includes the start time. Editing retains the existing past start time and does not reject updates or retries because it is earlier than the current time
fields.help_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，策略时区下的 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss，不带时区偏移，秒位固定 00。区间包含开始时刻；编辑保留已有的过去开始时间，不因其早于当前时间拒绝更新或重试
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The target maximum number of instances. This field is required. Valid values: 1 to 100
fields.name: max_instances

fields.help_en: The target minimum number of instances. This field is required. Valid values: 0 to 100. The value cannot be greater than maxInstances in the same item
fields.help_zh: 必填，0～100，且不大于同项 maxInstances
fields.name: min_instances

fields.help_en: The list of days in a month. This field is required for each trigger point of monthly policies. It cannot be empty and must be deduplicated. Valid values: integers from 1 to 31. Each row is selected independently. If a date does not exist in a month, the policy is not triggered and is not postponed to the end of the month. This field must be omitted for other cycles
fields.help_zh: 仅 monthly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～31；每行独立选择，月份不存在的日期不触发，不顺延到月末。其他周期必须省略
fields.name: month_days

fields.help_en: The trigger time. This field is required. Format: HH:mm:ss. It is interpreted in the time zone of the policy, accurate to the minute, and the seconds are fixed at 00
fields.help_zh: 必填，HH:mm:ss，按所属策略时区解释，精确到分钟，秒位固定 00
fields.name: time

fields.help_en: The list of weekdays. This field is required for each trigger point of weekly policies. It cannot be empty and must be deduplicated. Valid values: integers from 1 to 7. 1 indicates Monday, and 7 indicates Sunday. Each row is selected independently. This field must be omitted for other cycles
fields.help_zh: 仅 weekly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～7，1 为周一、7 为周日；每行独立选择。其他周期必须省略
fields.name: weekdays

fields.help_en: The periodic trigger time points. This field is required and cannot be empty. Each item must be complete. The day of the week or day of the month is configured independently for each item. Within the same policy, daily policies conflict if the time is the same. weekly and monthly policies conflict only when the time is the same and the date sets intersect. This is validated by the console
fields.help_zh: 必填且非空，每项必须完整。星期或月日期由每项独立配置。同一策略内，daily 相同 time 冲突，weekly/monthly 仅在 time 相同且日期集合相交时冲突，由 Console 校验
fields.name: time_points

fields.help_en: The policy time zone. This field is required and must be a valid IANA time zone. All dates and times in this policy are interpreted in this time zone
fields.help_zh: 必填，合法 IANA 时区。本策略所有日期和时间均在该时区下解释
fields.name: time_zone

fields.help_en: The policy validity period type. This field is required. Valid values: forever: Long-term validity. range: Short-term validity. After expiration, the policy and its trigger results exit the current calculation, and the remaining policies are recalculated. If no candidates exist, the basic values are restored. The saved configuration is not automatically deleted
fields.help_zh: 必填，forever 为长期有效，range 为短期有效。到期后策略及其触发结果退出当前计算并重算剩余策略；无候选恢复基础值，保存的配置不自动删除
fields.name: validity

fields.help_en: The complete list of dynamic policies. This field is required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original list is retained. If provided, it replaces the entire list and is not merged by ID. To clear the list, you must ensure that the final enabled is set to false. Each item must be complete. Conditional requirements and cross-field constraints are validated by the server. The display order does not indicate priority
fields.help_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原列表，传入即整体替换，不按 id 合并。清空须同时保证最终 enabled=false。每项必须完整，条件必填和跨字段约束由服务端校验；显示顺序不作为优先级
fields.name: policies

fields.help_en: The dynamic policy configuration. It must be fully provided during creation. If omitted during an update, the original configuration is retained. If provided, it is merged by field and does not accept null. The response returns the saved complete configuration. If no historical dynamic configuration exists, it is normalized to enabled=false and policies=[]
fields.help_zh: 创建时完整提供；更新时省略表示保留，传入时按字段合并，不接受 null。响应返回保存的完整配置，历史无动态配置规范化为 enabled=false、policies=[]
fields.name: dynamic_policy

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the global auto-elasticity mode. This field is independent of dynamicPolicy.enabled. If omitted during an update, the original value is retained
fields.help_zh: 与 dynamicPolicy.enabled 独立。更新时省略表示保留原值
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The saved basic maximum number of instances. Valid values: 0 to 100. The value cannot be less than minSandboxCount. The basic upper and lower limits are used when dynamic scaling is disabled or no candidates exist
fields.help_zh: 0～100，且不小于 minSandboxCount。动态关闭或无候选时使用基础上下限
fields.name: max_sandbox_count

fields.help_en: The saved basic minimum number of instances. Valid values: 0 to 100. The value cannot be greater than maxSandboxCount. It must be submitted in pairs with maxSandboxCount during an update. Omitting both retains the original values. It does not override dynamic results when dynamic candidates exist
fields.help_zh: 0～100，且不大于 maxSandboxCount。更新时与 maxSandboxCount 成对提交，省略二者表示保留原值；有动态候选时不覆盖动态结果
fields.name: min_sandbox_count

fields.help_en: Accepted only when updateElasticity is set to true. Omitting subfields retains the original values. The basic minSandboxCount and maxSandboxCount must be submitted in pairs. dynamicPolicy.enabled and policies can be updated separately. If policies is provided, it replaces the entire list. To clear the list, you must ensure that the final dynamicPolicy.enabled is set to false. elasticityPolicy and dynamicPolicy do not accept null, and an empty patch is invalid. Only Router endpoints and DEFAULT endpoints of the GATEWAY_API_WITH_VPC_INGRESS or GATEWAY_API_WITH_PUBLIC_INGRESS type support elasticity updates. The server merges, validates, and saves the complete configuration without backfilling basic values with the current capacity. The final basic min and max values must be between 0 and 100. If the historical basic capacity exceeds the limit, you must submit valid basic min and max values even if you only modify the dynamic policy. Silent truncation is not allowed
fields.help_zh: 仅 updateElasticity=true 时接受。省略子字段表示保留原值；基础 minSandboxCount/maxSandboxCount 须成对提交，dynamicPolicy.enabled 与 policies 可分别更新，policies 传入即整体替换。清空列表必须保证最终 dynamicPolicy.enabled=false。elasticityPolicy、dynamicPolicy 不接受 null，空 patch 不合法。仅 Router 类型与 GATEWAY_API_WITH_VPC_INGRESS 或 GATEWAY_API_WITH_PUBLIC_INGRESS 类型的 DEFAULT 服务端点支持更新弹性。服务端合并、校验并保存完整配置，不以当前容量回填基础值。最终基础 min/max 须满足 0～100；历史基础容量超限时，即使只改动态策略也须同时提交合法基础 min/max，不能静默截断
fields.name: elasticity_policy

fields.help_en: Used to modify existing named endpoints that support renaming. If omitted, the original name is retained. Router and hybrid ingress endpoints do not support renaming. You can only omit this field or pass the original name. This field is prohibited for DEFAULT endpoints
fields.help_zh: 用于修改支持改名的存量命名端点；省略表示保持原名称。Router 和混合入口端点不支持改名，只能省略或传原名称；DEFAULT 端点禁止传入此字段
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable public inbound access for the service endpoint. If omitted, the original value is retained. If set to true or false, the value is replaced. Explicit null or non-boolean values return InvalidParameter and do not provide restore inheritance semantics. Modifying only this field triggers an ingress revision only and does not redeploy the runtime instance. Whether public network access is actually enabled is also subject to the public inbound access limit of the workspace. For more information, see effectivePublicAccessEnabled in the response
fields.help_zh: 不传表示保持原值；传 true 或 false 时替换。显式 null 或非布尔值返回 InvalidParameter，不提供恢复继承语义。只改该字段仅触发入口修订，不重新部署运行实例；实际是否开放公网还受工作空间公网入向上限约束，见响应中的 effectivePublicAccessEnabled
fields.name: public_access_enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to explicitly update the elasticity configuration in this request. If omitted or set to false, the elasticityPolicy carried in this request is ignored, and the saved configuration is retained. If set to true, a valid and non-empty elasticityPolicy patch and clientToken must be provided. This field is not persisted, returned, or passed through to the resource manager, and has no default value. Omit this field during regular editing and version rebinding
fields.help_zh: 省略或 false 时忽略本次携带的 elasticityPolicy，保留已保存配置；true 时必须携带合法非空的 elasticityPolicy patch 和 clientToken。不持久化、不返回、不向 RM 透传，不设置默认值。普通编辑和改绑版本时省略
fields.name: update_elasticity

parameters.help_en: The service endpoint configurations to be modified in this request. Submit the supported modifiable name, bound version, invocation authentication configuration, elastic policy, or public inbound access switch based on the endpoint type. Router and hybrid ingress endpoints cannot be renamed. DEFAULT endpoints do not accept name or authentication configuration updates. When updating the elastic policy, you must specify both updateElasticity=true and clientToken
parameters.help_zh: 本次需要修改的服务端点配置，按端点类型提交支持修改的名称、绑定版本、调用认证配置、弹性策略或公网入向开关。Router 和混合入口端点不可改名，DEFAULT 端点不接受名称或认证配置更新。更新弹性策略时须同时传入 updateElasticity=true 和 clientToken
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: The idempotent request token. This field is required when updateElasticity is set to true and is validated by the server. Reuse the token and the original request for the same retry. Use a new token if the logical content changes. Using the same token with different content returns InvalidParameter. The token must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), colons (:), and hyphens (-). The scope is the tenant and workspace. The receipt is retained for 7 days from the time of successful acceptance. Replays do not extend the retention period. After expiration, it is revalidated as a new submission
parameters.help_zh: updateElasticity=true 时必填，由服务端校验。同次重试复用 token 和原请求，逻辑内容变更使用新 token；同 token 不同内容返回 InvalidParameter。token 为 1～128 位英文字母、数字或 ._:-，作用域为租户与 Workspace；回执自成功受理起保留 7 天，重放不续期，到期后按新提交重新校验
parameters.name: client_token

code.description_en: The response code of the request. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful
code.description_zh: 本次请求的响应码，成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The service endpoint information returned after the update is accepted. This includes the binding target, saved authentication and elasticity configurations, and current status. The endpoint may still be updating
data.description_zh: 成功受理更新后返回的服务端点信息，包括绑定目标、保存的认证和弹性配置及当前状态。端点可能仍在更新中

accessUrls.description_en: The list of access URLs for the service endpoint
accessUrls.description_zh: 服务端点的访问地址列表

accessType.description_en:
The access URL type. Valid values:
INTERNET
VPC

status.description_en:
The access URL status. Valid values:
CREATING
READY
DEGRADED

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the access URL status. This parameter is returned with the specific cause when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 访问地址状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

authentication.description_en: The authentication configuration of the service endpoint

type.description_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:
NONE: No authentication is required.
API_KEY: Authentication is performed by passing the API key in the x-api-key request header
type.description_zh: 鉴权方式。NONE 表示无需鉴权，API_KEY 表示通过 x-api-key 请求头传递 API Key 进行鉴权

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC format compliant with RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

currentInstances.description_en: The read-only current number of instances. The Get operation queries RM sandboxPhaseCounts.RUNNING by endpoint runtimeKey. The Create and Update operations return null. The value is a non-negative integer, and null is returned when the statistics are unavailable. The value is not replaced by the base upper and lower limits, target quantity, or READY status. Unavailable statistics do not block submission
currentInstances.description_zh: 只读，Get 按 Endpoint runtimeKey 查询 RM sandboxPhaseCounts.RUNNING；Create/Update 返回 null。非负整数，统计不可获得时返回 null；不以基础上下限、目标数量或 READY 状态替代，统计不可获得不阻塞提交

effectivePublicAccessEnabled.description_en: The result of combining publicAccessEnabled with the workspace-level public inbound access limit. The value is true only when both settings allow public inbound access. This field only indicates the policy target and does not mean that the public endpoint has been fully provisioned. To determine the actual status, refer to accessUrls and status
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.description_zh: publicAccessEnabled 与工作空间公网入向上限叠加后的结果：二者均允许时为 true。仅表示策略目标，不代表公网入口已发布完成，实际状态以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.title_en: 服务端点公网入向的有效期望值
effectivePublicAccessEnabled.title_zh: 服务端点公网入向的有效期望值

elasticityPolicy.description_en: The complete elasticity configuration saved for the service endpoint, which is used for edit backfill and is not the current effective upper and lower limits or the actual number of instances. The Get operation preferentially returns the saved configuration. If no configuration is saved, an endpoint that supports elasticity backfills the base values from the expected runtime frozen configuration or the bound version configuration when the runtime is not yet established, without requiring a successful publication. The value is null when the source is temporarily unavailable or no applicable configuration exists, but the status and statusReason are still returned. The Create and Update operations return only the saved configuration, and the value is null if no configuration is saved. The historical base capacity may exceed 100, and the read value is not truncated
elasticityPolicy.description_zh: 用于编辑回填，不是当前生效上下限或实际实例数。Get 优先返回保存配置；未保存时，支持弹性的 Endpoint 从期望 runtime 冻结配置或尚未建立 runtime 时的绑定版本配置回填基础值，不要求发布成功。来源暂缺或无适用配置时为 null，仍返回 status/statusReason；Create/Update 仅返回已保存配置，未保存时为 null。历史基础容量可超过 100，读取不截断

dynamicPolicy.description_en: The saved dynamic configuration. If the base configuration before the requirement goes online lacks the dynamicPolicy parameter, it is supplemented with enabled=false and policies=[]
dynamicPolicy.description_zh: 返回保存的动态配置；需求上线前的基础配置缺 dynamicPolicy 时补为 enabled=false、policies=[]

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the dynamic policy. This field is required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original value is retained. Disabling it retains existing policies and restores the basic upper and lower limits. Re-enabling it triggers immediate calculation. When finally enabled, policies cannot be empty
enabled.description_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原值。关闭保留已有策略并恢复基础上下限，重新开启立即计算；最终开启时 policies 不得为空

policies.description_en: The complete list of dynamic policies. This field is required during creation. If omitted during an update, the original list is retained. If provided, it replaces the entire list and is not merged by ID. To clear the list, you must ensure that the final enabled is set to false. Each item must be complete. Conditional requirements and cross-field constraints are validated by the server. The display order does not indicate priority
policies.description_zh: 创建时必填；更新时省略保留原列表，传入即整体替换，不按 id 合并。清空须同时保证最终 enabled=false。每项必须完整，条件必填和跨字段约束由服务端校验；显示顺序不作为优先级

endTime.description_en: The end time of the validity period. This field is required only when validity is set to range. The format is the same as startTime, and the seconds are fixed at 00. It must be later than startTime. The interval does not include the end time. If validity is set to forever, the start and end times must be omitted. Valid dates and cross-field constraints are validated by the console
endTime.description_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，格式与 startTime 相同，秒位固定 00，必须晚于 startTime；区间不包含结束时刻。forever 必须省略起止时间；合法日期和跨字段约束由 Console 校验

id.description_en: The policy identifier. This field is required and must be unique and stable within the endpoint. It is generated by the frontend when added, and retained during editing and retries
id.description_zh: 必填，Endpoint 内唯一且稳定；新增时由前端生成，编辑和重试保留

priority.description_en: The policy priority. This field is required. Valid values: 5: Regular. 10: High. New policies default to regular. You must explicitly provide this field upon submission, as the API does not set a default value. When the final dynamicPolicy.enabled is set to true, the validity periods of high-priority policies cannot overlap, except for end-to-end connections. Long-term high-priority policies can overlap with other high-priority policies. When disabled, overlapping drafts can be saved, and the final configuration is validated upon re-enabling. The validity of other fields and trigger conflicts within the policy are always validated. You must explicitly provide priority
priority.description_zh: 必填，5 为常规，10 为高优；新增策略默认选择常规，提交时显式携带，不设置接口默认值。最终 dynamicPolicy.enabled=true 时，高优策略之间有效期不得重叠，首尾相接允许，长期高优与其他高优重叠；关闭时允许保存重叠草稿，重新开启时校验最终配置。其他字段合法性与策略内触发冲突始终校验；priority 必须显式提供

repeat.description_en: The repeat cycle. This field is required. Valid values: daily: Every day. weekly: Every week. monthly: Every month. Only submit the fields corresponding to the cycle
repeat.description_zh: 必填。daily 为每天，weekly 为每星期，monthly 为每月；仅提交对应周期的字段

startTime.description_en: The start time of the validity period. This field is required only when validity is set to range. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss in the policy time zone, without a time zone offset. The seconds are fixed at 00. The interval includes the start time. Editing retains the existing past start time and does not reject updates or retries because it is earlier than the current time
startTime.description_zh: 仅 validity=range 必填，策略时区下的 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss，不带时区偏移，秒位固定 00。区间包含开始时刻；编辑保留已有的过去开始时间，不因其早于当前时间拒绝更新或重试

timePoints.description_en: The periodic trigger time points. This field is required and cannot be empty. Each item must be complete. The day of the week or day of the month is configured independently for each item. Within the same policy, daily policies conflict if the time is the same. weekly and monthly policies conflict only when the time is the same and the date sets intersect. This is validated by the console
timePoints.description_zh: 必填且非空，每项必须完整。星期或月日期由每项独立配置。同一策略内，daily 相同 time 冲突，weekly/monthly 仅在 time 相同且日期集合相交时冲突，由 Console 校验

maxInstances.description_en: The target maximum number of instances. This field is required. Valid values: 1 to 100

minInstances.description_en: The target minimum number of instances. This field is required. Valid values: 0 to 100. The value cannot be greater than maxInstances in the same item
minInstances.description_zh: 必填，0～100，且不大于同项 maxInstances

monthDays.description_en: The list of days in a month. This field is required for each trigger point of monthly policies. It cannot be empty and must be deduplicated. Valid values: integers from 1 to 31. Each row is selected independently. If a date does not exist in a month, the policy is not triggered and is not postponed to the end of the month. This field must be omitted for other cycles
monthDays.description_zh: 仅 monthly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～31；每行独立选择，月份不存在的日期不触发，不顺延到月末。其他周期必须省略

items.description_en: The day of the month. Valid values: 1 to 31. If the date does not exist in the current month, the policy is not triggered
items.description_zh: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发
items.title_en: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发。
items.title_zh: 月内日期，范围为 1～31，所在月份不存在的日期不触发。

time.description_en: The trigger time. This field is required. Format: HH:mm:ss. It is interpreted in the time zone of the policy, accurate to the minute, and the seconds are fixed at 00
time.description_zh: 必填，HH:mm:ss，按所属策略时区解释，精确到分钟，秒位固定 00

weekdays.description_en: The list of weekdays. This field is required for each trigger point of weekly policies. It cannot be empty and must be deduplicated. Valid values: integers from 1 to 7. 1 indicates Monday, and 7 indicates Sunday. Each row is selected independently. This field must be omitted for other cycles
weekdays.description_zh: 仅 weekly 的每个触发点必填，非空且去重，整数 1～7，1 为周一、7 为周日；每行独立选择。其他周期必须省略

items.description_en: The weekday index. Valid values: 1 to 7. 1 indicates Monday, and 7 indicates Sunday
items.description_zh: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日
items.title_en: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日。
items.title_zh: 星期序号，1 为周一，7 为周日。

timeZone.description_en: The policy time zone. This field is required and must be a valid IANA time zone. All dates and times in this policy are interpreted in this time zone
timeZone.description_zh: 必填，合法 IANA 时区。本策略所有日期和时间均在该时区下解释

validity.description_en: The policy validity period type. This field is required. Valid values: forever: Long-term validity. range: Short-term validity. After expiration, the policy and its trigger results exit the current calculation, and the remaining policies are recalculated. If no candidates exist, the basic values are restored. The saved configuration is not automatically deleted
validity.description_zh: 必填，forever 为长期有效，range 为短期有效。到期后策略及其触发结果退出当前计算并重算剩余策略；无候选恢复基础值，保存的配置不自动删除

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the global auto-elasticity mode. This field is independent of dynamicPolicy.enabled. If omitted during an update, the original value is retained
enabled.description_zh: 与 dynamicPolicy.enabled 独立。更新时省略表示保留原值
enabled.title_en: 是否开启整个自动弹性模式
enabled.title_zh: 是否开启整个自动弹性模式

maxSandboxCount.description_en: The saved or backfilled base maximum number of instances, which is not less than minSandboxCount. The historical value may exceed 100, and the read value is not truncated. The base value is used when dynamic scaling is disabled or no candidates are available
maxSandboxCount.description_zh: 保存或回填的基础最大实例数，不小于 minSandboxCount。历史值可超过 100，读取不截断；动态关闭或无候选时使用基础值
maxSandboxCount.title_en: 保存的基础最大实例数
maxSandboxCount.title_zh: 保存的基础最大实例数

minSandboxCount.description_en: The saved or backfilled base minimum number of instances, which is a non-negative integer and not greater than maxSandboxCount. The historical value may exceed 100, and the read value is not truncated. A newly written complete configuration must still meet the 0 to 100 range
minSandboxCount.description_zh: 保存或回填的基础最小实例数，非负且不大于 maxSandboxCount。历史值可超过 100，读取不截断；新写入的完整配置仍须满足 0～100
minSandboxCount.title_en: 保存的基础最小实例数
minSandboxCount.title_zh: 保存的基础最小实例数

elasticityPolicy.title_en: 服务端点保存的完整弹性配置
elasticityPolicy.title_zh: 服务端点保存的完整弹性配置

endpointType.description_en:
The service endpoint type. Valid values:
DEFAULT: The default endpoint created and maintained by the platform.
NAMED: The named endpoint explicitly created by the user
endpointType.description_zh: 服务端点类型。DEFAULT 表示由平台创建并维护的默认端点，NAMED 表示用户显式创建的命名端点

name.description_en: The service endpoint name. The name must be unique within the workspace and 1 to 128 characters in length
name.description_zh: 服务端点名称。在工作空间内唯一，长度为 1~128 个字符

publicAccessEnabled.description_en: The expected public inbound access setting configured on the service endpoint. For legacy service endpoints that have not been configured, true is returned. This field only indicates the configuration expectation. To determine the actual availability of the public endpoint, refer to accessUrls and status
publicAccessEnabled.description_zh: 用户在服务端点上设置的公网入向期望；未设置过的历史服务端点按 true 返回。仅表示配置期望，实际公网地址是否可用以 accessUrls 与 status 为准
publicAccessEnabled.title_en: 服务端点公网入向开关的期望值
publicAccessEnabled.title_zh: 服务端点公网入向开关的期望值

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the service endpoint
regionId.description_zh: 服务端点所在的地域 ID

status.description_en:
The service endpoint status. Valid values:
CREATING
READY
UPDATING
DEGRADED
DISABLED
DELETING

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the service endpoint status. This parameter is returned with the specific cause when the status is abnormal
statusReason.description_zh: 服务端点状态原因。状态异常时返回具体原因
statusReason.example: ServiceEndpoint.Provider.Unavailable: no provider for the target type

target.description_en: The target routing configuration of the service endpoint
target.description_zh: 服务端点的目标路由配置

agentId.description_en: The target agent ID. This parameter is returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentId.description_zh: 目标智能体 ID。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

agentVersion.description_en: The target agent version. This parameter is returned when the target type is AGENT_VERSION
agentVersion.description_zh: 目标智能体版本号。目标类型为 AGENT_VERSION 时返回

collaborationComponent.description_en: The collaboration component type. This parameter is returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
collaborationComponent.description_zh: 协作组件类型。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

resourceBindingId.description_en: The workspace resource binding ID associated with the target collaboration component. This parameter is returned when the target type is TEAM_COLLABORATION
resourceBindingId.description_zh: 目标协作组件关联的工作空间资源绑定 ID。目标类型为 TEAM_COLLABORATION 时返回

targetType.description_en:
The target type. Valid values:
AGENT_VERSION
TEAM_COLLABORATION

updatedAt.description_en: The last update time in UTC format compliant with RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request. The value is 200 if the request is successful
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求对应的 HTTP 状态码，成功时为 200

message.description_en: The response message of the request. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 本次请求的响应消息，成功时为 success

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates that the update request is accepted, but does not mean that the deployment or endpoint change is complete. You must check data.status and data.accessUrls to confirm the result
success.description_zh: true 表示更新请求已成功受理，不代表部署或入口变更已完成；结果须结合 data.status 和 data.accessUrls 查询确认
